observationLimits: Hub and companion panels are opened/closed through actual native window tabs; shadow row/actions are checked from actual catalogue using installed Hub model code. Pixel layout, rendered DOM and human visual sign-off are not_run and are not asserted by these functional cases.

Case07 registration uses a temporary in-memory installed bobApi loader wrapper delegating to real native source APIs; exactly one controlled registerWorkflow failure is injected. Product disk bytes remain unchanged.
Case07 cancellation observes real installed extension scoped showQuickPick and real workbench closeQuickOpen; picker results are not simulated. Other restored hosts wait for one elected probe owner.
Case09 records real boundary errors, unchanged workspace run files and provider dispatch=0; a Bob task-invocation counter is unavailable through the public API, so none is fabricated.
Case10 string checkpoint selectors may omit guarded V2 runs; physical snapshot/journal bytes stay identical without claiming all selectors throw.
V1 persistence creates/saves/loads real physical files using the installed guarded store; no AI/Bob task execution is invoked.
Native runtime restored multiple dedicated-profile development windows; all complete, partial and failed attempts are retained with their original status, not replaced by the accepted pass reports.
